baseline_reuse: Completed ten-day original-return arms, same source and 1500 updates

change.hypothesis: A single bounded follow-up: target scaling severely overfits two training days; test whether ten training days mitigate that failure at identical 1500 updates. This is not a repetition on the same data or a claim that scaling is already accepted.

decision: All four period-by-metric differences (RankIC and long-short) must be nonnegative to justify independent seeds; if not, stop this scaling hypothesis without extra LR/scale search. A seed11 interaction signal remains exploratory. No automatic promotion.
